description: Next free queue slot of one account on any network, as `{scheduledAt}` (ISO time, null when no schedule is configured or every slot is booked). Pass it as scheduledAt of create_post. Requires the SCHEDULE_READ scope (key issued by the workspace owner).

channel.description: Network of the account, e.g. INSTAGRAM (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

name: get_next_free_slot
title: Get next free posting slot
